test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A rectangular field is to be fenced on three sides leaving a side of 30 ft. uncovered. If the area of the field is 690 sq. ft., how many feet of fencing will be required?
solution:
**Given:**

Uncovered side (length) = 30 ft

Area of the field = 690 sq. ft

**Formula used:**

Area = length × width

Fencing required = 2 × width + length

**Calculation:**

690 = 30 × width

⇒ width = (690)/(30)

⇒ width = 23 ft

Fencing required = 2 × 23 + 30

⇒ Fencing required = 46 + 30

⇒ Fencing required = 76 ft

**∴ The required length of fencing is 76 ft.**
